name: Contraptions 22: road tips (Momentum Bubbles 19)
description: A road network grown by solitons (Momentum Bubbles 19): one tip sets off east, laying road (the road reagent, the network: 1 fresh, ageing toward 2) and, every road length, dropping a bud that hatches a new tip heading off at right angles, to the side the side field says (painted as smooth noise). Tips hold their heading and run straight; one that has gone a little way and runs onto old road dies there, so streets end in T-junctions. A city grid grows; later, blocks keep dividing and it fills in (there's no minimum block size yet), and now and then a bunch of close parallel streets grows. Paint side to choose which way branches go; clock_rate for the road length.
